'''''Star Wars: Mace Windu''''' is a [[canon]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic miniseries]] written by [[Marc Bernardin]] and drawn by [[Georges Jeanty]] and published by [[Marvel Comics]] from [[February 7]] to [[May 15]], [[2024]]. The series was collected in the trade paper back ''[[Star Wars: Mace Windu – The Twilight Run]]''.<ref name="TPB" />
